_about: Transit under construction (engine/construction.py). Lines are drawn from OpenStreetMap ways whose name matches 'match' (fetched by engine/fetch_construction.py); a line with no OSM geometry yet is left off. Stations come from OSM where mapped. Only facts the owner has published go in 'opens' (Province of BC, via Daily Hive's September 2026 construction update). No closures feed: the Province, not the City, permits the subway's street work, and the City's Road Ahead lists its own projects only.

lines.name: Broadway Subway
lines.about: Extends the Millennium Line west from VCC–Clark under Broadway to Arbutus Street, mostly in a tunnel.

lines.name: Surrey Langley SkyTrain
lines.about: Extends the Expo Line from King George in Surrey along Fraser Highway to Langley City Centre, on an elevated guideway.
